snippet.title: Battle Nation (WINE) Levels 01-11 Gameplay
snippet.description:
Originally developed for Windows 32 bits in Blitz Basic 2D, back in 2001/2002.

You can download from https://archive.org/details/bnation101.

It should work on modern Windows 10, but here it is shown running via Linux on Wine.

Troubleshooting: Game uses native full screen 640x480 resolution, which may not be supported depending on the system. If that's the case, run the game with command line option '-w' for windowed mode.
